Alzheimer's Disease (AD)

A progressive neurodegenerative disorder that leads to memory loss, cognitive decline, and behavioral changes, profoundly affecting patients’ independence and quality of life.

Technology Highlights: Our novel approach has identified a small-molecule compound targeting a specific mechanism, demonstrating significant improvement in cognitive function.

Obesity

A chronic metabolic condition marked by excessive body fat, increasing the risk of serious health issues such as cardiovascular disease, diabetes, and hypertension.

Diabetes

A metabolic disorder characterized by high blood sugar levels, which can lead to complications including cardiovascular disease, kidney damage, and retinopathy, affecting overall health and lifespan.

Technology Highlights: Our innovative approach optimizes key target proteins to regulate neural pathways, achieving effects similar to GLP-1 therapies. This breakthrough offers a highly effective strategy for managing both obesity and diabetes.
